summary: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions (AITX) furnished a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 9, 2026, attaching a press release announcing Q3 orders for two RIO 360 units, one RIO Mini, one ROSA, and four SARA licenses, all sourced from existing customer and channel relationships. No transaction, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock was disclosed. The filing is a routine business update rather than a special situation, and no deal terms apply.
